title: A triboelectric-piezoelectric-electromagnetic self-powerd wearable sensor for long-term human rehabilitation training monitoring.
summary: The primary article’s Methods and Results show that machine-learning classification of sensor signals enabled measured gesture recognition and gait-impairment detection; the claim is limited to the tested setting. The result is reported in Scientific Reports. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
